name: X Bilsenter (site + CRM)
install: for p in . x-bilsenter ../x-bilsenter; do [ -f "$p/.cursor/install.sh" ] && cd "$p" && break; done; bash .cursor/install.sh
start: for p in . x-bilsenter ../x-bilsenter; do [ -f "$p/.cursor/start.sh" ] && cd "$p" && break; done; bash .cursor/start.sh

terminals.name: admin-crm (8090)
terminals.command: for p in . x-bilsenter ../x-bilsenter; do [ -f "$p/.cursor/start.sh" ] && cd "$p" && break; done; cd ../x-bilsenter-admin/server && NODE_ENV=production node index.js

terminals.name: site-web (8080)
terminals.command: for p in . x-bilsenter ../x-bilsenter; do [ -f "$p/.cursor/start.sh" ] && cd "$p" && break; done; NODE_ENV=production node server/index.js
